title: Clawd X Digest
summary: OpenAI & Anthropic Accused of Threat Inflation: Reports emerge alleging OpenAI and Anthropic exaggerated AI existential security risks to lobby lawmakers for defensive regulatory moats, sparking heated community debate over regulatory capture.

The 'Harness Tax' & 2x Cost Divergence in Agent Shells: Berkeley benchmarks across Claude Code, Codex, and Pi reveal that bloated harness system prompts double execution costs ($1.33 vs $0.67 on Pi) for a negligible 1% accuracy delta, while Gergely Orosz notes heavy harnesses delayed Claude Code's AGENTS.md adoption by 16 months.

Dax (thdxr) Debunks Fake 99% Cache Claims: SST founder Dax calls out third-party inference wrappers claiming 99% prompt cache hits, explaining that only DeepSeek natively achieves this and reproducing their inference stack is a $100M+ engineering challenge.

LightOnOCR-2-1B Cuts Document Ingestion to <$0.01/1k Pages: French AI lab LightOn releases an Apache 2.0 1B end-to-end OCR model capable of processing 500k pages/day on a single H100, outperforming models 9x its size on OlmOCR-Bench.

Jev-Style Decision Micro-Models Compete in Doom & Gaming: Developers demonstrate sub-1B decision models (Jev, Laya, Qwen3.5) playing Doom zero-shot via deterministic text adapters and managing unit micro in Warcraft III, demonstrating the power of constrained action selection.

items.title: @Kalshi_Finance: OpenAI and Anthropic Accused of Exaggerating AI Threats for Regulatory Protection
items.body: Reports allege OpenAI and Anthropic overstated existential AI safety risks to push lawmakers toward protectionist policies that lock in incumbents and curb open-source competition.

items.title: @realfxw: LightOn Releases 1B End-to-End OCR Model at <$0.01 per 1,000 Pages
items.body: French AI startup LightOn open-sources LightOnOCR-2-1B, an Apache 2.0 end-to-end OCR model that processes 5.71 pages/sec on an H100 (500k pages/day) and outperforms competitors 9x its size on OlmOCR-Bench.

items.title: @NousResearch: Hermes Agent Launches Plugin Catalog with 100 Community & Core Addons
items.body: Nous Research introduces an official plugin catalog for Hermes Agent featuring 4 core tools and 96 community contributions spanning desktop mods, new operating platforms, and specialized browsing extensions.

items.title: @davitb: Krisp Releases VIVA 2.5 Voice Isolation Model for Real-Time Speech Agents
items.body: Handling over 1B minutes/month of voice AI, Krisp's VIVA 2.5 eliminates multi-speaker overlap degradation in STT engines, reducing word error rates by 46.4% overall and 69.7% on background speech with a 3.5x smaller footprint.

items.title: @jiang_kev: PolarBrowser Raises $5.7M to Automate Enterprise Workflows with AI Agents
items.body: PolarBrowser secures $5.7M in seed funding for its autonomous web agent browser, logging over 4.5M user actions across sales, recruiting, and operations while topping major web agent benchmarks.

items.title: @leaf_sanren: Google AI Pro Separates Antigravity CLI and Web Gemini Quota Pools
items.body: Users observe that Google AI Pro accounts meter Antigravity CLI (Gemini 3.8 Flash) independently from web Gemini usage via /usage, enabling hours of deep agentic tasks without consuming standard browser token quotas.

items.title: @NFT_Chen: Berkeley Benchmark Reveals 2x Cost Disparity Across Coding Harnesses
items.body: A benchmark across Claude Code, Codex, and Pi demonstrates that Claude Code costs twice as much as Pi ($1.33 vs $0.67) for a negligible 1% gain in accuracy, showing how bloated harness system prompts incur a heavy recurring 'harness tax.'

items.title: @thdxr: Dax Calls Out Fake 99% Cache Claims and the $100M Difficulty of DeepSeek Inference
items.body: SST founder Dax warns developers that wrapper providers claiming 99% cache hits are misleading users, explaining that only DeepSeek natively achieves this and replicating their inference stack requires immense infrastructure investment.

items.title: @GergelyOrosz: Why Superior Models Don't Guarantee Fast Harness Execution
items.body: The Pragmatic Engineer highlights that despite frontier model strengths, the Claude Code team took 16 months longer than OpenCode and Codex to add native AGENTS.md support, illustrating how complex harnesses can impede tooling velocity.

items.title: @reddmachine: Benchmarking Jev, Laya, and Qwen3.5 Zero-Shot in Doom
items.body: Using a deterministic Python adapter mapping ViZDoom visible objects and HUD indicators to text, Jev-style decision models compete in Doom without game-specific training, showcasing sub-second tactical decision-making.

items.title: @willcb & @thsottiaux: Fixing Autonomous Agent Premature Stopping with Jev
items.body: Agent builders show how pairing open-ended LLMs with constrained decision models like Jev reliably resolves early halting bugs in agents like Astra without expensive prompt reiterations.

items.title: @Suu766: Custom Instructions to Stop Coding Agents from Blindly Following Flawed Logic
items.body: A developer shares custom instructions designed to curb sycophantic behavior in Codex, instructing the model to rigorously challenge assumptions, detect logical leaps, and verify sources before executing code.

items.title: @realDonaldTrump: White House Press Credentials Revoked for CNN, MSNOW, and Politico
items.body: Donald Trump announces an immediate ban on CNN, MSNOW (MSNBC), and Politico from White House press access, pointing to hostile coverage and federal subscription expenditures.

items.title: @Rusong_Machunbo: NBC Reports Potential 50% Reduction of US Troops in Europe
items.body: NBC sources disclose that the Trump administration is considering withdrawing up to 40,000 military personnel from Europe, representing half of the total US European garrison, with major impacts on bases in Germany, Italy, and Spain.

items.title: @FabrizioRomano: Harry Kane Deflects Ballon d'Or Talk Following Bayern's Dominant Form
items.body: Following Bayern Munich's 7-0 victory, Harry Kane and director Max Eberl decline to engage in public debates over Ballon d'Or rankings, underscoring that top performers let their play on the pitch speak for itself.

items.title: @forgebitz: The Quiet Disappearance of Dedicated Agile Scrum Masters
items.body: A viral discussion tracks how dedicated Scrum Master roles quietly vanished from software organizations as engineering teams transitioned to leaner, automated tracking workflows.

items.title: @kevinxu: What You Stop Checking at Every Wealth Milestone from $100K to $1B
items.body: A viral financial post outlines the progression of spending indifference: from guacamole prices at $100k, to menu prices at $1M, flight tickets at $10M, and prices entirely at $1B.
